Address receiving withdrawal fees.

View helper computing withdraw amount and withdrawal fee for a share amount.

Returns lockedAmount plus the vault's asset balance.
Returns the freely withdrawable asset balance of the vault.
Returns maximum shares withdrawable accounting for locked amount and minimum supply.

Sets immutable asset, factory, adapter, WETH, USDC, swap contract and token decimals.
External caller controlled address used for deposits, withdrawals and access control.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for option readiness and delay checks.
Low-level value call msg.sender.call{value: withdrawAmount} in withdrawETH.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the token source in safeTransferFrom for deposit.
msg.sender is the recipient of the ETH low-level transfer in withdrawETH.
msg.sender receives minted shares in _deposit.
msg.sender shares are burned and withdrawal is attributed to msg.sender.
onlyManager requires msg.sender == manager to change withdrawal fee.
onlyManager gate on setNextOption.
onlyManager gate on rollToNextOption.
onlyManager gate on emergencyWithdrawFromShort.
onlyManager gate on sellOptions.
onlyManager gate on setCap.
block.timestamp is used to set nextOptionReadyAt, a timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp > nextOptionReadyAt gates rolling to the next option.
withdrawETH performs a low-level value call that transfers control to msg.sender.
The external low-level call can re-enter withdrawETH before state finalization.
rollToNextOption delegatecalls the adapter to close and create shorts.
emergencyWithdrawFromShort delegatecalls the adapter to close the short.
deposit calls _deposit after transferring tokens.
depositETH calls _deposit after wrapping ETH.
withdraw invokes _withdraw to burn shares and compute amount.
withdrawETH invokes _withdraw before unwrapping WETH.
_withdraw calls withdrawAmountWithShares to compute withdraw and fee amounts.
withdrawAmountWithShares calls _withdrawAmountWithShares for share math.
maxWithdrawableShares result is used via withdrawAmountWithShares in maxWithdrawAmount.
_deposit calls totalBalance to read total vault assets before minting.
rollToNextOption uses totalBalance/asset balances to size the short.
rollToNextOption reads the free asset balance via assetBalance logic.
cap is compared against totalWithDepositedAmount in _deposit.
instantWithdrawalFee is multiplied into the withdrawal fee computation.
lockedAmount is included in total assets for share-to-asset math.
asset immutable is used to build option terms and read balances in rollToNextOption.
currentOption is read as oldOption before rolling.
nextOption is read as the new short target in rollToNextOption.
nextOptionReadyAt gates rollToNextOption via timestamp comparison.
feeRecipient receives the fee transfer inside _withdraw.
manager state variable is compared to msg.sender in onlyManager for setNextOption.
manager state variable gates rollToNextOption.
manager state variable gates emergencyWithdrawFromShort.
manager state variable gates sellOptions.
manager state variable gates setCap.
manager state variable gates setWithdrawalFee.
asset is queried via balanceOf in assetBalance.
lockedAmount is added to the free balance in totalBalance.
_owner parameter is validated and used to transfer ownership in initialize.
_feeRecipient parameter is assigned to feeRecipient in initialize.
_initCap parameter sets cap in initialize.
_tokenName parameter initializes the ERC20 name.
_tokenSymbol parameter initializes the ERC20 symbol.
amount parameter flows into the transfer and deposit accounting.
share parameter flows into _withdraw burn computation.
optionTerms parameter is used to resolve the option address.
order parameter is validated and forwarded to SWAP_CONTRACT.swap.
newCap parameter is written into cap.
account parameter is used to read the share balance against maxWithdrawableShares.

normalization_plan.reason: _owner is a parameter consumed only by initialize and should be folded into that function node.
_feeRecipient is a parameter consumed only by initialize.
_initCap is a parameter consumed only by initialize.
_tokenName is a parameter consumed only by initialize.
_tokenSymbol is a parameter consumed only by initialize.
amount is a parameter of deposit and should be folded into that function node.
share is a parameter of withdraw and should be folded into that function node.
optionTerms is a parameter of setNextOption.
order is a parameter of sellOptions.
newCap is a parameter of setCap.
account is a parameter of the share-balance query implemented by maxWithdrawableShares.
share local is computed and minted inside _deposit.
withdrawAmount local is computed and sent via low-level call inside withdrawETH.
